answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce TRAN, an innovative tuning-free framework that enhances the self-alignment capabilities of LLMs in a streaming setting, without additional training data. TRAN utilizes an iterative process of generating and accumulating rules based on observed mistakes, enabling LLMs to avoid repeating similar mistakes.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates rules in 'if..., then...' format, answers to multiple-choice questions, and classifications for text.
